DiagnosticLevel.description: Payload size for diagnostics (independent of structural `detailLevel`).

oneOf.description: Plus raw traceback / full TD dumps.

OpPath.description: Operator path string passed to TD for resolution via `td.op()`.

Pid.description: OS process id — sole address for tools and queues.

ScriptDependency.description:
A declared dependency on something outside the script.

A bare string is shorthand for an OP path, which is the common case and what
the bridge accepts. Two kinds are recognised, `op` and `module`; a wider
vocabulary would mean inventing dependency semantics this tool has no basis
for.

oneOf.description: Store a source and return an immutable ref. **Never executes it.**
Return one source, including its body.
The roster of registered sources, without their bodies.
Forget a source in the registry.
Execute a registered source through the inline `execute_python` path.
Resolve a source's declared dependencies and report staleness.

action.description: What to do. Defaults to `register`, the only non-executing default.

contextPath.description:
Optional context path, forwarded to the run exactly as `execute_python`
takes it.

daemonId.description: Optional federated daemon id (omit for local / unique remote resolve).

dependencies.description: What the source needs, resolved and reported on every run.

diagnosticLevel.description: Diagnostic payload size (`summary` omits raw traceback).

name.description: Optional human name, recorded once and not part of the ref's identity.

sourceId.description:
The content address returned by `register`. Required by every other
action.
